title: The plants told the Amazonians how to make ayahuasca

tellings.quote: They will say well the plants told us

plain: Peoples of the Amazon say the plants themselves taught them how to make ayahuasca, a psychedelic brew made from two plants. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore reports this without naming a source: asked how they found the recipe, "they will say well the plants told us." If taken at face value, it would mean knowledge can come from the plants or from the states they open.
